verses: A Ma῾alot Poem for Shelomo. Unless the Lord builds the house, they who build it labour in vain: unless the Lord keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of toil: for truly to his beloved he gives tranquillity.
Lo, children are a heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is a reward.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man; so are the children of one’s youth.
Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be put to shame, but they shall speak with their enemies in the gate.
